office_does: District Court judges hear misdemeanor and gross misdemeanor criminal cases, traffic infractions, civil suits up to $100,000, small claims, protection orders and felony first appearances for Clark County.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge James B. Smith is the only candidate for Department 3.

candidates.summary: District Court judge since 2021 (appointed, elected 2022), assistant presiding judge overseeing Veterans Therapeutic Court, and a former deputy prosecutor; the only candidate.
highlights: Appointed in 2021, elected 2022; assistant presiding judge [S1]
